text:
Julian: kicking off this week's model triage for onboarding candidates — primary focus: cerulean-8b intake + quick prioritization. posting current perf/quality summary and asking for sprint owners. please drop a 1-5 priority and any known blockers.

Anya: +1. early eval looks promising on general LMs. suggest prioritization 4 for prod-sim workloads. missing long-doc QA.

Rajesh: priority 3 from infra/quant view — we should run a 4-bit quant smoke to sanity-check hallucination regressions before we move higher. saw weird tokenization edgecases on a subset.

Eva: FYI ran fast rouge/bertscore quickchecks on news/summ bench — cerulean-8b full-precision: ROUGE-L ~0.68, BERTScore ~0.91; quant 4-bit drop ~3-4% on ROUGE for long summaries. that's small but concentrated on entity preservation.

Mike: capacity note: Dedicated pool has spare A10 nodes but core perf for 8b inference is better on A100 T4 pairing. if we need steady throughput for experiments maybe pre-warm 2 nodes. cost vs latency tradeoff TBD. cc @Julian

Kari: I'll own quant smoke. running the following today; will post results in thread.
```
# quick eval
python eval/run_eval.py --model cerulean-8b --quant 4bit --batches 100 --bench summarization --output /tmp/cerulean_q4.json
```
\nKari: also adding a small prompt set for entity tests (10 examples) — if anyone has extra cases drop them here.

Anya: adding two long-doc cases from customer support dataset, will DM link.

Rajesh: question about fallback policy — if q4 has quality regressions, do we want automatic fallback to fp16 in Dedicated? that impacts routing config.

Julian: yes — suggested policy: prefer q4 for cost but fallback to fp16 on per-route regression threshold. @Mike please list config knobs we need in routing to enable this.

Mike: will draft a routing patch: low-lat fallback + cost-budget window, and a canary percent for q4. ETA tomorrow.

Eva: noted a couple of prompt patterns that trigger hallucinations post-quant — will attach minimal repros after Kari's run.

Kari: quick update — started run, first 25 batches done, seeing similar small ROUGE drop; pushing full run now. ETA ~25m.

oncall-bot: Deployment window tomorrow 09:00 UTC reserved for model benching (eng-ml). Reminder: notify infra 30m before.

Julian: thanks all. action items: Kari run + post results; Mike config draft for fallback/canary; Anya + Eva add long-doc & entity repros; Rajesh to schedule a 30m sync if quant run shows >5% regression. I'll reconvene Friday 11:00 to decide prioritization move-to-sprint (tentative). :thumbsup:
